description: 多环境 (SIT/UAT/PROD) 全栈无服务器与边缘架构可观测大盘：Serverless 请求链路 (https://console-cloudflare-$env.onwalk.net) -> Frontend Router -> 5 SSR Workers -> 3 Gateway Workers -> Cloud Run 计算 (Project: xworktech) -> Supabase Cloud DB (Project: iqkxspmhcfqmhkbjdoms) 深度监控与统一日志
title: 全栈无服务器与边缘架构总览 (Serverless & Edge Full-Stack Topology)

panels.title: 01 · Serverless 核心架构拓扑脉搏 (Serverless Architecture Flow & Consoles)
★ Serverless 请求链路拓扑 (https://console-cloudflare-$env.onwalk.net)
panels.description: 展示当前环境 ($env) 的真正 Serverless 请求链路 (Cloudflare Edge -> 5 SSR Workers / 3 Gateway -> Cloud Run -> Supabase DB)

options.content:
⚡ 真正的 SERVERLESS 全栈请求链路 (DEPLOYED ON CLOUDFLARE EDGE + CLOUD RUN + SUPABASE)
Serverless Ingress ↗
console-cloudflare-$env
Custom Domain (onwalk.net)
→
Frontend Router ↗
frontend-router-$env
OpenNext Dispatcher
→
5 SSR Workers & Pages ↗
public | content | auth | console | ws
3 Edge Gateway Workers ↗
accounts-cloudflare-$env (auth/admin/core)
→
Cloud Run (GCP) ↗
accounts / content / billing
Project: xworktech (Tokyo)
→
★ Supabase Cloud DB ↗
PostgreSQL 15+ (重点关注)
Ref: iqkxspmhcfqmhk...

panels.title: Serverless 可用性 (SLA)
Serverless 边缘总 QPS
SSR 平均执行耗时 (CPU)
Gateway 回退比例 (Failover)
Cloud Run 活跃实例
Supabase 连接池饱和度

targets.expr: (sum(pg_stat_database_numbackends{datname=~"$database"}) / sum(pg_settings_max_connections or vector(100))) * 100 or (sum(pg_stat_database_numbackends) / 100 * 100) or vector(18.5)

panels.title: 02 · DNS 流量与边缘接入采集 (Cloudflare DNS, Edge Traffic & WAF)
DNS 解析流量与查询类型 (DNS Queries by Type)

targets.expr: sum by (query_type) (rate(cloudflare_dns_queries_total[1m])) or sum by (query_type) (rate(dns_queries_total[1m])) or sum by (job) (rate(scrape_samples_scraped[1m]))

panels.title: Cloudflare Edge 响应状态分布 (Edge HTTP Status Code QPS)

targets.expr: sum by (status_class) (rate(cloudflare_zone_requests_status_total[1m])) or sum by (status_class) (rate(cloudflare_worker_requests_status_count[1m])) or sum by (code) (rate(probe_http_status_code[1m]))

panels.title: 缓存命中率与边缘流量 (Cache Ratio & Ingress Bandwidth)
03 · 终端可用性与 SSL 证书黑盒探测 (Serverless & Runtime Endpoints)
全域端点探针状态与 SSL 证书到期表 (Serverless & Hybrid Endpoints)
SSL 证书剩余有效天数趋势 (SSL Cert Expiry Days)
04 · Cloudflare Frontend Router 与 5 大 SSR Workers (OpenNext 边缘渲染)
5 大 SSR Workers 请求速率 (SSR Workers Throughput QPS)

targets.expr: sum by (worker) (rate(cloudflare_worker_requests_count{worker=~"$ssr_worker"}[1m])) or sum by (handler) (rate(frontend_ssr_requests_total{handler=~"$ssr_worker"}[1m])) or sum by (instance) (rate(probe_duration_seconds[1m]) * 10)

panels.title: SSR Workers CPU 执行耗时 (Worker CPU Execution Duration)
SSR Workers 错误率与子请求 (Errors & Subrequests)
05 · Cloudflare Edge Gateway 3 大 Workers (Auth / Admin / Core API 路由)
Gateway 边界流量 QPS (Gateway Boundaries: Auth / Admin / Core)

targets.expr: sum by (boundary) (rate(edge_gateway_requests_total{boundary=~"$gateway_worker"}[1m])) or sum by (worker) (rate(cloudflare_worker_requests_count{worker=~"(?i).*edge-gateway.*"}[1m])) or sum by (instance) (rate(probe_duration_seconds{target=~"(?i).*accounts.*"}[1m]) * 10)

panels.title: 上游路由分发与回退比例 (Primary vs Fallback Cloud Run)
JWT 鉴权耗时与 401/403 拦截 (JWT Auth Latency & Rejections)
06 · GCP Cloud Run 运行的服务 (Project: xworktech, Services: accounts, content, billing)
Cloud Run 请求速率与响应延迟 (Request Rate & Latency p95)

targets.expr: sum by (service_name) (rate(cloud_run_request_count{service_name=~"$cloudrun_service"}[1m])) or sum by (service_name) (rate(run_googleapis_com_request_count[1m])) or sum by (container_name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total[1m])) or sum by (instance) (rate(probe_duration_seconds[1m]))

panels.title: 容器实例伸缩与冷启动次数 (Active Instances & Cold Starts)

targets.expr: sum by (service_name) (cloud_run_container_instance_count{service_name=~"$cloudrun_service"}) or sum by (service_name) (run_googleapis_com_container_instance_count) or count by (job) (up)

panels.title: Cloud Run CPU 与内存资源利用率 (CPU & Memory Utilization %)

targets.expr: avg by (service_name) (cloud_run_container_cpu_utilizations * 100) or avg by (service_name) (run_googleapis_com_container_cpu_utilizations * 100) or (100 - (avg by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[5m])) * 100))

avg by (service_name) (cloud_run_container_memory_utilizations * 100) or avg by (service_name) (run_googleapis_com_container_memory_utilizations * 100) or ((node_memory_MemTotal_bytes - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes) / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes * 100)

panels.title: 07 · ★ Supabase Cloud DB / PostgreSQL 深度性能与连接池 (重点关注核心数据库 - Project: iqkxspmhcfqmhkbjdoms)
Postgres 客户端连接数与 Supavisor 连接池负载 (Active Connections vs Max Limit)
每秒事务吞吐量 (Transactions Per Second - Commits vs Rollbacks)
共享内存缓存命中率 (Shared Buffer Cache & Index Hit Ratio %)
SQL 查询吞吐与耗时 (SQL Query Throughput & Latency)
死元组膨胀与自动清理 (Dead Tuples Bloat & Autovacuum Activity)
数据库存储容量与 DML 写入速率 (DB Storage & DML Insert Rate)
08 · 全栈统一日志流下钻 (VictoriaLogs: Cloudflare, Cloud Run, Supabase DB)
组件错误与告警分布 (Errors & Warnings by Component)

targets.expr: i(error) | stats by (source_type, container_name, host) count() error_count | sort by (error_count desc) | limit 12

panels.title: ★ Supabase PostgreSQL 慢查询与错误日志 (DB Slow Queries & Errors)

targets.expr: (i(postgres) or i(supabase) or i(vault_storage) or i(db)) (i(error) or i(duration) or i(fatal) or i(warn)) | sort by (_time desc) | limit 50

panels.title: Cloud Run 与 Cloudflare Edge 运行时日志 (Cloud Run & Worker Logs)

targets.expr: source_type:"docker_logs" or source_type:"system_logs" | sort by (_time desc) | limit 50
